about.title: About - CROW SYSTEMS
about.description: Crow Systems is a two-person engineering team - one senior network engineer and one senior software engineer - building reliable systems for growing businesses.
about.heading:
We're Engineers Who Take the Time
to Understand Your Business
about.description1: Crow Systems is two senior engineers who got tired of watching businesses get burned by overpriced consultants and software that doesn't deliver. One of us focuses on networks, infrastructure, and secure communications. The other builds backend systems, data pipelines, and APIs. Together, we cover everything your business needs - no account managers, no handoffs, just the people who actually do the work.
about.description2: We work directly with founders and operators who need real engineering expertise without the overhead of a big firm or a full internal team. When you work with us, you work with the owners, two senior engineers who treat your business like their own.
about.missionText: To give growing businesses direct access to senior engineering owners - no account managers, no finger-pointing, just reliable systems built by the people who stand behind them.
about.visionText: Technology should empower businesses, not slow them down. Every company - regardless of size - should have the engineering expertise they need to build with confidence.
valueItems: Honest answers, even when it's hard
Built to last, not to flip

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - CROW SYSTEMS
privacy.description: Read the Privacy Policy for Crow Systems to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Crow Systems collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Crow Systems respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you visit our website or engage our consulting services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.intro: We may collect the following information:

sections.title: 3. How Information Is Used
sections.intro: Collected information may be used to:
items: Respond to inquiries and consultation requests
Provide and improve our consulting services
Improve website functionality and user experience
Maintain security and reliability of our systems
sections.extra: Crow Systems does not sell personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Audio Submission Handling
sections.content: Audio recordings submitted through the website may be temporarily stored and processed for consultation review purposes. Users should avoid submitting highly sensitive, confidential, or regulated information unless a formal agreement is in place.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Analytics
sections.extra: Analytics data is used to improve user experience and website performance.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Providers
sections.content: Crow Systems may use third-party providers for hosting, file storage, form processing, analytics, and email delivery. These providers process data according to their own privacy policies and applicable regulations.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
sections.content: Crow Systems implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect submitted information. This includes encryption of data in transit and at rest. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. Data Retention
sections.content: Information is retained only as long as necessary for business operations, legal obligations, service delivery, and security monitoring. Unused or outdated information may be periodically deleted.

sections.title: 9. User Rights
sections.extra: Requests may be submitted to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

sections.title: 10. International Users
sections.content: Users accessing the website from outside the operating region acknowledge that information may be processed in jurisdictions different from their own, in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

sections.title: 11. Children's Privacy
sections.content: The website and services are not intended for children under 13 years of age. Crow Systems does not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes to Privacy Policy
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

sections.title: 13. Contact Information
sections.content: Questions regarding privacy may be directed to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

terms.description: Read the Terms of Service for Crow Systems technology consulting services and website usage.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using our website or services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using the Crow Systems website and services, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, you should not use the website or services.

sections.title: 2. Services
sections.content: Crow Systems provides technology consulting, advisory services, digital solution planning, and related professional services. Services include systems consulting, IT infrastructure, software solutions, technical strategy, digital transformation, and automation consulting. All services are provided subject to availability and project scope agreements.

sections.title: 3. Use of Website
items: Use the website lawfully and in accordance with these terms.
Avoid submitting malicious, abusive, or misleading content.
Avoid attempting unauthorized access to systems or infrastructure.
Avoid misuse of forms, APIs, or upload systems.
Provide accurate and complete information when submitting inquiries or requests.
sections.extra: Crow Systems reserves the right to block or restrict access to abusive users.

sections.title: 4. Consultation Requests
sections.content: Submitting a consultation request does not establish a formal business relationship or contractual agreement. Project work, pricing, timelines, and deliverables require separate written agreements. Our team will review your submission and respond within 1 business hour.

sections.title: 5. Audio Submissions
sections.intro: Users may voluntarily submit audio recordings through the website. By submitting audio content, users confirm:
items: They own or have rights to the submitted content.
The content does not violate laws or third-party rights.
The content does not contain malicious or prohibited material.
sections.extra: Crow Systems reserves the right to reject or remove inappropriate submissions. Audio recordings are handled securely and used solely for consultation review purposes.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All website content, branding, design elements, text, graphics, and materials are the property of Crow Systems unless otherwise stated. Users may not reproduce, distribute, or reuse materials without prior written permission.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.intro: Crow Systems is not liable for:
items: Business interruption or loss of profits
sections.extra: All services are provided on an "as available" basis.

sections.title: 8. Third-Party Services
sections.content: The website may integrate with third-party providers including hosting, form processing, storage, analytics, and communication platforms. Crow Systems is not responsible for third-party service interruptions, policies, or data handling practices.

sections.title: 9. Privacy
sections.content: Use of the website is also governed by our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 10. Changes to Terms
sections.content: Crow Systems may update these Terms of Service periodically. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: Questions regarding these Terms may be sent to legal@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

systemsConsulting.title: Systems Consulting
systemsConsulting.description: We audit how your teams work with technology - fixing operational bottlenecks, eliminating silos, and streamlining workflows that slow you down.
systemsConsulting.fullDescription: Systems aren't just servers and code - they're the workflows, tools, and processes your teams use every day. We audit your entire operational stack, identify where things get stuck, and deliver a clear plan to unblock your teams. Whether it's fragmented tools, disconnected departments, or manual processes that should be automated, we bring clarity and structure to complex environments.
systemsConsulting.idealFor: Growing businesses experiencing operational friction, duplicated efforts across teams, or those relying on outdated manual processes that no longer scale.

itInfrastructure.title: IT Infrastructure
itInfrastructure.description: We design and build the networks, servers, and cloud infrastructure your business runs on - reliable, secure, and built to scale.
itInfrastructure.fullDescription: Your infrastructure is the foundation everything else depends on. We design and build networks, server architecture, cloud environments, and disaster recovery plans that keep your business online - even under peak demand. From AWS to on-prem, we build foundations that grow with you, not against you.
features: Disaster recovery and business continuity planning
itInfrastructure.idealFor: Businesses that depend on always-on systems, handle sensitive data, or are scaling infrastructure to meet growing demand.

softwareSolutions.title: Software Solutions
softwareSolutions.description: We build custom software - internal tools, customer platforms, and everything in between - that fits your exact workflows.
softwareSolutions.fullDescription: Off-the-shelf software often creates more problems than it solves. We design and build custom applications tailored to your exact workflows and business rules. From internal tools and dashboards to customer-facing platforms and automated pipelines, we engineer solutions that fit like a glove. Every line of code is written with maintainability, performance, and your long-term goals in mind.
features: Custom web and mobile application development
API design and integration layer development
softwareSolutions.idealFor: Teams with unique workflows that generic software cannot address, or organizations looking to replace brittle legacy tools.

technicalStrategy.title: Technical Strategy
technicalStrategy.description: We help leadership teams make confident technology decisions - architecture choices, build-vs-buy, no hype, no lock-in.
technicalStrategy.fullDescription: Every technology decision has a long tail. We help leadership teams cut through the noise and make clear, informed choices about architecture, tooling, and investment. No vendor pitches, no trend-chasing - just sound engineering judgment and a phased roadmap that balances speed with sustainability. We translate business goals into technical plans, evaluate trade-offs clearly, and make sure you own your own destiny.
technicalStrategy.idealFor: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and growth-stage companies navigating complex technology decisions without in-house senior expertise.

digitalTransformation.title: Digital Transformation
digitalTransformation.description: We modernize legacy systems and unify your data so your team can make decisions based on facts, not gut feelings.
digitalTransformation.fullDescription: Digital transformation gets a bad name because it usually means 'replace everything.' We take a different approach - we modernize the systems that matter most and connect your data into a single source of truth. The result is dashboards you can trust, reports that actually help, and a team that can make decisions in hours instead of weeks. No unnecessary disruption, just practical progress.
digitalTransformation.idealFor: Established businesses with aging systems looking to modernize operations, unlock data insights, and improve decision-making speed.

automationConsulting.title: Automation Consulting
automationConsulting.description: We eliminate repetitive manual work - from deployment pipelines to data entry - so your team can focus on what actually moves the business forward.
automationConsulting.fullDescription: Repetitive manual work is a silent killer of productivity and morale. We identify the highest-impact opportunities to eliminate it through smart automation - CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, robotic process automation, and scheduled data workflows. The goal isn't automation for its own sake - it's freeing your team to do the creative, strategic work that actually moves the needle.
features: Scheduled data processing and ETL automation
automationConsulting.idealFor: Operations-heavy teams spending excessive time on repetitive tasks, deployment-heavy engineering teams, or businesses preparing to scale without proportional headcount growth.
